summary.text: XPOVIO (selinexor), a first-in-class oral XPO1 inhibitor with orphan designation for multiple myeloma, was reviewed under Priority review and granted accelerated approval based on the ORR observed in the single-arm STORM trial. Because ORR reflects only a short-term benefit, the ongoing phase 3 BOSTON trial (KCP-330-023) was required as the confirmatory trial to verify clinical benefit. An ODAC meeting was convened and voted to delay approval pending BOSTON results.
